fields.explanation: Fill online, then courier or speed post the signed form with supporting documents. It is the only mode open to a minor — s.160 of the Income-tax Act bars eKYC and e-Sign once a Representative Assessee is appointed — and the site already ships it selected. Set explicitly so a changed default cannot silently reroute the application.

fields.pause_message: Type the guardian's PAN in the highlighted box, then click Continue
fields.pause_body: FormYaar never asks for or stores a PAN number, so this one is yours to type. Everything else about the guardian fills in automatically once you continue.
fields.explanation: The one field the applicant fills by hand. A PAN is the most sensitive identifier on this form, so it is never collected in the panel, never stored and never sent anywhere — the fill stops here and waits for a Continue click. It also has to come first: the site keeps the guardian's middle-name box disabled until a PAN is present.
Guardian's first name, in full — the form rejects initials.

fields.explanation: The minor's proof of identity, as picked in the panel. Not hardcoded to Aadhaar the way the eKYC flow can afford to be.
The minor's proof of address, as picked in the panel.
The minor's proof of date of birth.
The "I/We ___, in the capacity of" name in the declaration. This is the GUARDIAN, not the child — the declaration is made by the Representative Assessee, and a minor cannot make it themselves.
Declaration capacity — Representative Assessee. It is the only option the site renders on a minor's form; there is no Self.
Designation of the person signing. Spelled out in full — the field takes 30 characters and this is 24.
District the application is filed from. The date beside it is readonly and set by the page, so it is left alone.
The Name box below the date, above Designation. The guardian again — it names the person signing the declaration, which pairs with the REPRESENTATIVE ASSESSEE designation right under it.
Save Draft — preserves every filled field before the review screen.
